summary: Join our Small-Scale Livestock Development and Extension Course to gain essential skills in livestock management and sustainable farming practices.
lede: Small-scale livestock development and extension connect field diagnosis with practical advice producers can apply. Designed for extension officers, animal-health professionals, cooperative advisers and programme managers, the course covers production-system assessment, animal health and welfare, and producer learning activities. Participants also practise feed and husbandry planning, enterprise gross-margin analysis, and tracking adoption with field records and monitoring tools.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced professionals who support small-scale livestock producers, manage field programmes, or make decisions about animal health, production, markets, and rural livelihoods.
prerequisites: You should have intermediate experience in agricultural extension, livestock production, veterinary support, rural development, or programme monitoring. You do not need programming skills, veterinary licensure, or specialist data science knowledge. A working understanding of at least one livestock production system and access to representative farm information will improve application. Advanced digital topics remain at operational application and conceptual awareness level, while field assessment, extension planning, and dashboard design receive hands-on practice.
